PETOPIA · P1C My Pet · for your review

Foxy Animation Review

Codex drew four animation candidates from our Foxy. None of them are in the game yet. Each set is now cut at the real gaps between drawings, so no neighbouring frame shows and no tail is cut off. Every frame shares one size and one ground line, and the bath set was scaled down to match the others.

Eat

Eat: head in the bowl, chew, lick, happy heart.

Bathe

Bath: in the tub with bubbles, bubbles on the head, wet, shake dry.

Sleep

Sleep: lie down, curl up with the tail, breathe, wake and stretch.

Carry

Fetch: run back with the ball in the mouth (two strides), drop it, sit proudly.

Next to the child, at game size

From left: the child (42 px in the world), today's in-game Foxy at the child stage (22 px), then the candidates at that same Foxy size: eat, fetch with the ball in the mouth, bath shake, sleep. The candidates are softer and fluffier than the in-game Foxy, so the sizes match but the style still needs matching before use.
